- **Review of the forecasting method**: The Virginia suit was not in the expectation table. The 10-Q recorded the 10/19 notice, but it was not set as a trigger. From now on, when we open the legal-proceedings notes of a filing, we will also list 'considering suit' and notice-stage matters as trigger candidates (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T18].prev`).
- **Unpublished runs**: For 11/23, only the re-read of LL2 and DEF 14A was adopted. The Tesla 10-Q figures were not adopted because the original was not reopened. For the same reason, the earlier-executed 11/24 run reopened the sources of sections 1–4 above and adopted the same facts. Among them, the 11/23 trading volume was recorded as a value revised after the fact. 11/18·19 were already absorbed by the 11/20 run (source: `state.run.unpublished_runs`).
- **Publication gate memo**: All four runs (the earlier executions of 11/18·19·23·24) were blocked by a new failure in the repository selftest (test_cockpit). The cause is presumed to be the Mission Control data budget being exceeded. This run rewrote the trigger display field more briefly (details are preserved in a separate field). The fundamental remedy is a decision outside the judgment layer (source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
